instruction: In Google Search Settings, enable opening search results in a new window.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets the 'Results in a new window' toggle by exact label match via CDP JavaScript DOM traversal, which directly maps to the instruction requirement.
Metric correctly checks aria-checked == True (expected_state=true), confirming the toggle is enabled.
Postconfig opens google.com/preferences before evaluation, ensuring the preferences page is available and the getter can find the right tab.
Evaluator is negative-control resistant: task rationale confirms initial state is OFF, so a do-nothing agent will fail (checked=False != expected True).
Two-path getter (CDP primary + accessibility tree fallback) provides robustness against environment differences.
Single task requirement (enable toggle) is fully and precisely covered by the evaluator.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: If Google renames or localizes the toggle label, the exact text match would break. Consider a partial/case-insensitive match as a fallback.
Minor: The accessibility tree fallback uses a regex for 'checked'/'unchecked' which could produce false positives in some edge cases; the CDP primary path is more reliable.
